title: Pitch Black
description: Chloe conquers her fear of heights on an indoor climbing wall with the help of a trusting belayer.

scenes.narration: Chloe was terrified of heights, but she signed up for the indoor climbing gym's top-rope challenge to beat her anxiety.
scenes.visual: A teenage girl wearing a climbing harness looking up at a colorful indoor climbing wall.

scenes.narration: Halfway up the wall, her chalky hands began to shake and her boots slipped on a tiny plastic hold.
scenes.visual: Close-up of chalked hands gripping a bright resin climbing hold on an indoor wall.

scenes.narration: Looking down at the gym floor far below, her vision narrowed and her breath caught in her chest.
scenes.visual: A climber hanging on a rope looking down from high up near the ceiling beam.

scenes.narration: Her belay partner called up calmly from below, reminding her to trust the rope and take one steady step.
scenes.visual: A teenager standing on the gym floor below holding a belay device and looking upward.

scenes.narration: Chloe closed her eyes, reached for a firm volume pocket overhead, and pushed up through her heels.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a climber pushing off a rubber foot hold with determination and focus.

scenes.narration: She slapped the top anchor ring with a grin, looking out across the gym with a soaring feeling of triumph.
scenes.visual: A young woman reaching the top hold of a climbing wall with a joyous expression.

scenes.narration: Courage is just taking one small step at a time. Follow along for more stories like this every day.
scenes.visual: A happy teenage girl sitting on a gym mat with her climbing gear smiling widely.

character_reference: A young woman with shoulder-length wavy brown hair, wearing a grey athletic tank top, black climbing leggings, and a red harness with a chalk bag clipped to her waist.
